title: Sticky Chilli Oil Chicken
rawIngredients: 1 tsp Lee Kum Kee Chiu Chow Chilli Oil (plus extra to serve)
method: Preheat the oven to 200°C, gas mark 6. In a small bowl, whisk together the chilli oil (1 to 1½ tsp), soy sauce, marmalade, vinegar and 2 tbsp water.
Put the chicken, skin-side up, in a large roasting tin and pour over the sauce mixture. Roast for 25 minutes.
Remove the tin from the oven. Baste the chicken in the juices, then transfer to a plate. Stir up sticky bits from the bottom of the tin, then add the cabbage wedges, basting in the juices.
Sit the chicken on top of the cabbage, then roast for another 25 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and juices run clear.
Lift the chicken out of the tin and rest for 5 minutes. Serve chicken, cabbage, and pan juices drizzled with extra chilli oil.
